about_the_game:
Get ready to rumble on the dancefloor!

SHUFFLE SHOWDOWN catapults you into frantic, head-to-head rhythm battles - no holds barred flamboyant theatrics. Hit each beat on time to boost your popularity and charge your special meter, but miss a step and you'll stumble and lose your mojo.

Rig the odds with crazy accessories!

After every showdown, choose from a random selection of nearly 50 unique accessories. Will you choose to supercharge your moves or unleash clever tricks to troll your rival? Each run shuffles the stakes, with different tracks and builds to play - turning each and every match into a brand-new dance spectacle. It's a roguelite remix of rhythm that keeps you on your toes!

Two rival dancers, endless competition!

Face off locally against a friend as rival dancers hungry for stardom. Shuffle Showdown is designed to be played as couch PvP, so whether you're nailing combos or sabotaging your opponent you can be sure to expect taunts, reversals and one-upmanship as you out-dance, out-play and out-shuffle your opponent!

Groove to an original funky soundtrack!

The 100% original score pumps adrenaline through every face-off. Each track is engineered to sync with the rhythm and your moves, so feel the beat and let the music fuel your next show-stealing combo.

Infinite remix-ability!

With randomised accessories and tracks, every showdown hits differently. Master the meta and discover new synergies to keep the dancefloor unpredictable - then jump straight back in and shake shuffle things up all over again!

About the team

SHUFFLE SHOWDOWN is developed by Team Roland, and was born out of a university project gone much, much too far. We wanted to take our passion for creating games that make players feel excited (and occasionally crash out on their friends) and share it for free with anyone who might find it on Steam. Please forgive us if there are any bugs; as this is our first time shipping a game, SHUFFLE SHOWDOWN may have some technical issues we are unaware of. Many times the fix is as simple as restarting the game - sorry for the inconvenience.

Thank you so much for playing and we hope you have fun!

name: SHUFFLE SHOWDOWN

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 @ 3.1 GHz (or AMD equivalent)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics (Intel HD 4000 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K @ 3.5 GHz (or AMD Ryzen 3 1200)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 / AMD Radeon R7 370 (or better)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: Wacky rhythm action meets roguelike randomness! Every clash shuffles in new buffs and trolls, causing crazy rhythm chaos! Face off in 2-player local PvP and groove to a funky soundtrack with 10 original tracks designed to get you jamming and slamming (your controller!)
